title: Machine-learning-designed peptides show dual GCGR and GLP-1R activity
summary: An ensemble of multitask convolutional neural networks trained on 125 peptide analogues guided optimization of 15 synthesized variants. The study reports three potent dual agonists; P3 improved potency at both glucagon and GLP-1 receptors compared with the best dual agonist in the training set. These are cell-based receptor assays only. The paper reports weak performance for designing GCGR-selective peptides and establishes no clinical safety or therapeutic efficacy.
